```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
path <- "/fs/ess/PDE0023/bewell/fastqs/"
x <- list.files(path = path, full.names = F)
x <- gsub(".fastq.gz", "", x)
x
```
```{r}
df <- as.data.frame(x) %>%
  dplyr::rename("sample_name" = x) %>%
  mutate(project = "bewell",
         sample_type = "dna")

df2 <- as.data.frame(x) %>%
  dplyr::rename("sample_name" = x) %>%
  mutate(subsample = sample_name,
         protocol = "dna",
         seq_method = "single-read")
```

save
```{r}
write.csv(df, "/users/PAS1695/whee57/Github/Sapiens_be_gone/config/bewell-samples.csv", row.names = F)
write.csv(df2, "/users/PAS1695/whee57/Github/Sapiens_be_gone/config/bewell-subsamples.csv", row.names = F)
```
